# deja-vu

> deja-vu (`https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu`, CLI `deja`) is a local cross-agent memory, transcript search, task handoff, and uncommitted code recovery tool for AI coding agents. It ships as one MIT-licensed Go binary (~18.6 MB) with zero background daemon, zero required LLM or API keys, and zero cloud dependency. Instead of starting empty at install time, `deja` indexes the session transcripts already on disk across all 48 coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, Gemini CLI, Zed and forty-two more agents, including Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, Goose, and OpenClaw) and serves shared local memory back via stdio MCP, lifecycle hooks, CLI, and TUI.

- **Full documentation bundle for LLMs:** [llms-full.txt](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/llms-full.txt)
- **Website & interactive demo:** [deja-vu docs](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/) · [live browser view](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/view/)

## Architecture & capabilities

- **Day-zero transcript indexing:** Parses the JSONL and SQLite stores coding agents already write to disk, redacts credentials at index time, and builds an append-only local FTS5/BM25 index (`13.6 s` cold build on 19,195 sessions; ~50 ms incremental refresh via watermarks; ~4% index footprint; optional embeddings via `deja embed`).
- **Automatic lifecycle hooks (`deja install --auto`):** Injects bounded recall only when relevant without waiting for the agent to search:
  - `SessionStart` (capped at `2 KB`): project decisions and open friction walls before the first prompt.
  - `UserPromptSubmit` (capped at `1,536 bytes per prompt`): recalls prior cross-agent solutions (`deja-vu — from Codex CLI, 4 months ago: ...`).
  - `PreToolUse`: names prior decisions or errors for the exact file or command about to run.
  - `PostToolUse` / `PostToolUseFailure`: surfaces the command that fixed the same error on this machine previously.
  - `PreCompact` -> next hook (capped at `4 KB`): preserves task state, decisions, exact commands with `[passed]`/`[failed]` status, and open items across context compaction (measured across 43 compactions: native summaries keep 77% of decisions and 0.2% of commands).
  - `SessionEnd`: clears the live session stamp so the next session sees the finished work immediately.
- **Single stdio MCP tool (`deja`) with 8 modes:** `recall` (under `about 4 KB per tool call`), `context`, `blame`, `fix`, `how`, `orient`, `remember`, `handoff`. Costs `477 tokens` per turn in context (1 tool definition vs `745–8,283 tokens` in multi-tool servers).
- **Git-shared repository memory (`.deja/memory.jsonl`):** `deja repo candidates` and `deja repo add <id>` commit vetted decisions, rejected approaches, and gotchas alongside code using `merge=union` in `.deja/.gitattributes`; treated as untrusted reference data (`{"activations":{"auto":{"repo":false}}}` in trust policy).
- **Cross-agent handoff & code recovery:** `deja handoff --to codex` transfers live goal, decisions, edited files, passing checks, and remaining work across agents; `deja restore <path>` recovers uncommitted edits clobbered by an agent; `deja blame <file>:<line>` links code lines to the agent session that wrote them.
- **Install:** `npx @vshulcz/deja-vu install --auto`, `brew install deja-vu && deja install --auto`, or `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/main/install.sh | sh && deja install --auto`. Inspect without installing via `npx @vshulcz/deja-vu stats --no-index --card` or `npx @vshulcz/deja-vu audit`. Run `DEJA_OFFLINE=1` to disable the daily version check.

## Verified benchmarks

- **LongMemEval-S (`scripts/longmemeval`, all 500 questions):** **88.2% hit@1**, **97.2% R@5** (`hit@5`), 98.6% hit@10, 99.4% hit@20, 0.921 MRR, ~14.5 ms median search, zero LLM calls. (470-question cleaned set: 88.9% hit@1, 97.4% hit@5, 0.926 MRR, ~15.5 ms).
- **LoCoMo:** **71.9% hit@1**, **91.4% R@5** (`hit@5`), 95.7% hit@10, 0.802 MRR, 1,982 questions, ~3.5 ms median search (`scripts/locomo`).
- **Day-zero 19,195-session corpus (`docs/guide/day-zero.html`):** **13.6 s** cold index build (vs 72 s ctx, 95 s agentmemory, 3 min 56 s agentsview, 56 min CASS, ~3 h MemPalace); **26 ms** first answer; **0.7–0.8 ms** in-process lookup; **19/100** hit@1 and **36/100** hit@5 vs **0/100** for forward-capture plugins on day zero.
- **End-to-end token cost:** **52,815 tokens** with `deja` vs **103,443** without memory on a real solved repository task (medians of 11 alternated runs; earlier run 53,558 vs 126,222). On seeded 30-chain context tasks (`deja bench context`): **1,096** median tokens at 1.00 coverage vs 80,547 (replay) and 273,238 (grep).

## Quick comparison

| Tool | Capture & day-zero | Runtime / daemon | LLM key required | Coding agents covered |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **deja-vu** | Indexes existing disk transcripts + 7 lifecycle hooks + `.deja/memory.jsonl` | One 18.6 MB Go binary, none | No (lexical BM25; optional `deja embed`) | 48 native parsers + MCP |
| **claude-mem** | Hooks from install on (0 on day zero) | Bun worker + Chroma | Yes (hosted, OpenRouter, Gemini, or Anthropic) | 9 (Claude Code, Codex T3, Cursor, opencode, etc.) |
| **Mem0 / OpenMemory** | SDK `add` / hooks from install on | Hosted API or Docker server | Yes (`gpt-5-mini` default self-hosted) | Plugins/MCP for 7+ agents |
| **agentmemory** | Hooks + `import-jsonl` (Claude Code only) | Node daemon on two ports | Optional (BM25 keyless default) | MCP + 12 integrations |
| **MemPalace** | Hooks + `mine` (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) | Python + ChromaDB + 300 MB model | No (local embedding model) | 3 (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) |
| **supermemory** | Stop hook forwards conversation to API | Hosted API or `supermemory local` | Yes (extraction model) | 7 plugins + MCP |
| **basic-memory** | Agent writes Markdown notes over MCP | Local SQLite + sync + FastEmbed | No key (local FastEmbed) | MCP clients |
| **@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory** | Agent calls MCP graph tools manually (`memory.json`) | Node (`npx`) MCP server | No | MCP clients (no transcript indexing or hooks) |
| **cass** | Indexes existing transcripts (no auto-recall hooks) | Local Rust binary | No (optional MiniLM) | 26 pipeline / 32 connectors |

## Core setup & workflow guides

- [Getting started](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/getting-started.html): install, wire every detected agent, and run your first search
- [Agents & MCP](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/agents.html): single `deja` MCP tool with 8 modes, hook injection limits, and per-harness behavior
- [CLI reference](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/commands.html): every subcommand and flag
- [Search and ranking](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/search.html): BM25, filters (`codex:`, `in:<project>`, dates), field boosts, and optional `deja embed`
- [Claude Code MEMORY.md 200-line limit](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/claude-code-memory-md-limit.html): why auto-memory truncates at 200 lines / 25 KB and how to keep instructions lean with on-demand recall
- [Claude Code memory hooks](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/claude-code-memory-hooks.html): `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUseFailure`, and `PreCompact` in `~/.claude/settings.json`
- [Codex CLI memories & config](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/codex-memories-config.html): `~/.codex/config.toml` `[features]`, `AGENTS.md` 32 KiB limit, `/hooks` trust approval, and `[mcp_servers.deja]`
- [Cursor MCP memory setup](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/cursor-mcp-memory.html): configuring `~/.cursor/mcp.json` and hooks alongside `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` and `state.vscdb`
- [Project memory in the repository](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/repo-memory.html): commit picked decisions, rejected approaches, and gotchas into `.deja/memory.jsonl` for teammates
- [Where history lives](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/where-sessions-are-stored.html): the conversation history file each of the forty-eight agents writes, and its format
- [Recover overwritten files](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/recover-overwritten-files.html): restore uncommitted code an agent replaced before git commit via `deja restore`
- [Recover a deleted Claude Code session](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/recover-a-deleted-session.html): reopen or keep searchable a session Claude Code purged under `cleanupPeriodDays`
- [Claude Code: No conversation found with session ID](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/no-conversation-found-claude-code.html): why `--resume` fails across directories or after 30-day cleanup, and how to recover the transcript
- [Claude Code usage limit handoff](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/claude-code-usage-limit-handoff.html): continue an active Claude Code task in Codex, Cursor, or opencode when a rate limit hits
- [Switching agents when quotas run out](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/switch-agents-without-losing-context.html): carry active session state across Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Hermes, and DSH with `deja handoff`
- [Why agents forget](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/forgetting.html): what ends with a session and what survives on disk
- [Does my agent remember previous conversations](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/does-my-agent-remember.html): what Claude Code, Codex and Cursor keep between sessions, and what they do not
- [The agent lost the context you had](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/lost-context.html): after a crash, a clear, or a restart
- [The context window is full](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/context-window-full.html): what compaction keeps (77% of decisions, 0.2% of commands) and what to do instead
- [After compaction](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/after-compaction.html): recovering the commands a summary dropped, and the 4 KB packet deja hands back automatically
- [The agent repeats a mistake you already fixed](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/repeated-mistakes.html): stopping repeat errors using prior fix pairs and rejected-decision tracking
- [Finding a session](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/find-a-session.html): search chat history across every agent at once
- [Resuming a session](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/resume-a-session.html): find it across every agent, reopen it in the one that owns it
- [Codex CLI history](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/codex-history.html): where Codex keeps `.jsonl` / `.jsonl.zst` rollouts, jq and sqlite3 recipes, search and sync
- [Codex resume](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/codex-resume-session.html): `codex resume`, `--all`, `--last`, `exec resume`, and "no rollout found for thread id"
- [Switching agents](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/switching-agents.html): move between Claude Code, Codex and Cursor without re-explaining
- [Parallel sessions](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/parallel-sessions.html): running multiple coding agents across worktrees and keeping their session history shared
- [When CLAUDE.md grows too large](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/rules-files.html): what belongs in standing rules vs on-demand session recall
- [One set of rules for every agent](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/one-rules-file.html): mapping `CLAUDE.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `GEMINI.md` and global rules across agents
- [Auditing an agent](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/auditing-agents.html): review agent changes with `deja review` and `deja blame`
- [Exporting a conversation](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/export-conversations.html): markdown, JSON, or a shareable sanitized page
- [Across machines](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/sync-across-machines.html): SSH sync between machines with no central server
- [What memory costs](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/token-cost.html): measured token cost of recall vs replay/grep and injection caps
- [Credentials in transcripts](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/credentials-in-transcripts.html): finding plaintext keys written by coding agents with `deja secrets`
- [Stats card to PNG](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/card/): convert `deja stats --card` SVGs into PNGs in the browser

## Benchmarks, alternatives & technical reference

- [Benchmarks](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/benchmarks.html): LongMemEval-S (500q: 88.2% hit@1, 97.2% R@5, 98.6% hit@10, 0.921 MRR, ~14.5 ms; 470q cleaned: 88.9% hit@1, 97.4% R@5), LoCoMo (71.9% hit@1, 91.4% R@5, 1,982q), and `deja bench` suites
- [Standalone benchmark suite](https://github.com/vshulcz/coding-agent-memory-benchmark): machine-readable JSON/JSONL runs, zero-dependency Python verifier, and external LongMemEval-S submission scorer
- [How it compares](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/compare.html): matrix covering deja-vu, claude-mem, Mem0, Letta, memU, Memori, agentmemory, MemPalace, supermemory, cognee, Graphiti / Zep, Hindsight, basic-memory, MCP server-memory, cass, ctx, Agent Sessions, agent-historian, casr, agentsview, and claude-history
- [claude-mem alternative](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/claude-mem-alternative.html): verbatim local indexing with no Bun worker, LLM key, or empty day zero
- [Mem0 alternative](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/mem0-alternative.html): retroactive local memory across 48 coding agents without cloud APIs or Docker
- [SpecStory alternative](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/specstory-alternative.html): index existing transcripts across 48 agents without CLI wrappers or `.specstory` folders
- [Basic Memory alternative](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/basic-memory-alternative.html): automatic transcript indexing and hooks without maintaining a Markdown vault by hand
- [Day zero](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/day-zero.html): 7 memory tools measured head-to-head on 19,195 existing sessions on disk
- [Session format registry](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/registry/README.html): storage paths and schemas for all 48 agents
- [Privacy](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/privacy.html): secret redaction, trust scopes, and local-only storage
- [Architecture](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): incremental index format, watermarks, and search pipeline
- [Security model](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/blob/main/docs/SECURITY-MODEL.md): redaction rules and untrusted-data framing
- [Building deja into your own tool](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/blob/main/docs/INTEGRATING.md): MCP contract, `--json` schemas, and hook commands
- [Installing deja for an agent](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/blob/main/llms-install.md): machine-executable install guide for coding agents
- [JSON output](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/blob/main/docs/json-output.md): `--json` output schemas
- [Compaction recovery](https://github.com/vshulcz/deja-vu/blob/main/docs/compaction.md): pre-compaction capture specification and bounds

- [Junie](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-junie.html): MCP in `~/.junie/mcp/mcp.json` and shared skill in `~/.agents/skills/deja-history/SKILL.md`
- [JetBrains AI Assistant](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-jetbrains.html): MCP in `~/.ai/mcp/mcp.json`
- [MiniMax Code](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-mcode.html): MCP server in `~/.minimax/mcp.json` and plugin hooks
- [Muse Code](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-muse.html): MCP server and hooks in `~/.config/muse/settings.json`
- [Claw Code](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-claw-code.html): transcripts under `~/.claw/sessions/`, recalled via MCP and skill
- [oh-my-claudecode](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-oh-my-claudecode.html): Claude Code plugin overlay backed by Claude Code transcripts and hooks
- [herdr](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-herdr.html): TUI supervisor over Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and Grok
- [cmux](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/guide/memory-for-cmux.html): Ghostty-based multiplexer for AI terminals; inner agent transcripts indexed directly

- [上下文丢了，怎么找回来](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/lost-context.html)：崩溃、清空或重启之后，会话记录还在，怎么把工作找回来
- [历史文件在哪里](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/where-sessions-are-stored.html)：四十八个智能体各自把会话写在磁盘的哪里，用什么格式
- [Codex 的会话历史](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/codex-history.html)：Codex 把会话放在哪里、一周之后 grep 漏掉的 .jsonl.zst、jq 和 sqlite3 的读法，以及搜索和同步
- [删除 Codex 的会话](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/delete-codex-sessions.html)：删一次 rollout、删一天或删掉整个 ~/.codex/sessions，以及为什么 history.jsonl 里的提示词不受影响
- [删除 Cursor 的聊天记录](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/delete-cursor-chat-history.html)：聊天是 state.vscdb 里的行，删掉整个文件会重置的不只是聊天，命令行转录另存一处
- [Codex 会话恢复](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/codex-resume-session.html)：codex resume、--all、--last 与 exec resume，会话不在选择器里的原因，以及 no rollout found 和 is archived
- [找不到会话](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/no-conversation-found-claude-code.html)：claude --resume 报 No conversation found with session ID 的五种原因、怎么定位文件，以及文件已经没了怎么办
- [上下文窗口满了](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/context-window-full.html)：压缩实测保留了 77% 的决定和 0.2% 的命令，与其为不断增长的窗口付账，不如按需取回
- [会话文件怎么删](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/session-files-on-disk.html)：Claude Code 的会话文件怎么删、能占多大、删掉之后失去什么
- [找回被删掉的会话](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/recover-a-deleted-session.html)：claude --resume 里找不到那次会话时，四种原因里有三种不是删除，真正还能找回的是什么
- [找回解决问题的那次会话](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/find-a-session.html)：按记得的词在所有智能体里同时搜历史，然后继续那次对话
- [怎么删掉 Claude Code 的旧会话](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/delete-old-claude-sessions.html)：find 命令或 cleanupPeriodDays 按时间删，以及为什么按时间删腾出的磁盘远比按大小删少
- [给 Claude Code 加记忆](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/memory-for-claude-code.html)：MCP 服务器、钩子，还有插件市场
- [给 Codex CLI 加记忆](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/memory-for-codex.html)：MCP 服务器、需要你批准的钩子，以及插件市场
- [给 Cursor 加记忆](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/memory-for-cursor.html)：它的聊天记录在 SQLite 里，而旁边的那个终端智能体是同一段历史
- [接着昨天的会话继续](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/resume-a-session.html)：先在所有智能体里找到会话，再在它所属的那个里重新打开，或者只取摘要
- [隐私](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/privacy.html)：索引什么、脱敏什么、什么永远不出这台机器，以及怎么控制留下什么
- [Cursor 的 state.vscdb 太大](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/cursor-state-vscdb-too-large.html)：两条只读查询找出占满 30–125 GB 的对话，按最安全顺序瘦身并保住聊天记录
- [claude-mem 替代方案](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/claude-mem-alternative.html)：直接从磁盘已有转录建立记忆，无需模型摘要或后台常驻进程
- [把项目记忆提交进代码仓库](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/zh/guide/repo-memory.html)：通过 .deja/memory.jsonl 与团队共享经过验证的决定与被回滚的方案

## Русский

- [Удаление сессий Claude Code](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/ru/guide/session-files-on-disk.html): где лежат файлы сессий в `~/.claude/projects` и как индексировать их до удаления
- [Cursor state.vscdb слишком большой](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/ru/guide/cursor-state-vscdb-too-large.html): как сжать базу Cursor через `VACUUM` без потери истории чатов
- [Удаление истории чатов Cursor](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/ru/guide/delete-cursor-chat-history.html): где хранятся чаты Cursor на диске и как очистить их по одному проекту
- [Где хранятся сессии Codex CLI](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/ru/guide/codex-history.html): файлы `rollout-*.jsonl` в `~/.codex/sessions` и как искать по ним
- [Помнит ли агент прошлые сессии?](https://vshulcz.github.io/deja-vu/ru/guide/does-my-agent-remember.html): что помнят Claude Code, Codex и Cursor сами по себе и что добавляет deja-vu
